title: The host's areas -- where a change is costly to undo, and how far each class may spread (ADR-025)
description: Seeded once and owned by the host thereafter. An area is a set of paths and the cost of undoing a change to them, with the reason; a change's class is computed from the areas it touches. A path no area claims carries `default_undo`. The breadth numbers are the host's: a class absent from `max_areas` may span any number of areas.

default_proved_by.description: What proves a path no area claims; absent, every command a MUST names (ADR-025 amendment 4).

default_undo.description: The undo cost of a path no area claims, by its id on the work classes' scale.

max_areas.description: class id -> the most areas a change of that class may touch.

paths.description: A regular expression searched in a repository-relative POSIX path -- read exactly as an edit gate reads its `paths` (anchor it with ^ to mean a prefix).

at_least.description: The lightest class a change touching this area may be, by its id: tailoring a class upward where the undo cost alone does not say enough.

requires.description: Record ids a change touching this area owes beyond its class's -- a review where security lives, a decision where a public contract does.

owner.description: Who answers for this area -- a role or a team, never a guess. Named on weighing, so a change reaches the people it affects.

proved_by.description: The commands that prove a change to this area, as `<prefix>:<key>` a vouching declaration runs (ADR-025 amendment 4). Absent: a change here is proved by every command a MUST names -- the safe default, said when it is used. Empty: nothing beyond `check` proves it (prose, say).

drafted_as.description: Written by the areas verb on an area it drafted: the paths it drafted. While it still equals `paths`, the verb may redraft them (a root module's, once the kit planes are known); an area without it, or whose `paths` differ, is the host's and is never touched. Delete it to own the area.

feeds.description: The areas downstream of this one: its consumers, that must move with a change to it. Weighing a change names every area it feeds, transitively -- impact read from the map, never written as an essay per change (ADR-025 decision 12).
